teaser: Keeping everyone upright takes a toll nobody logs. You are a 33, the master teacher's path, crossed with ENTJ, the commander. The 33 asks for care poured out without keeping score; the ENTJ keeps score on everything, instinctively, the way a general counts supply lines. In you, the two fight and feed each other: the urge to heal and the urge to organize the healing into a plan with milestones. A room full of people who needed comfort gets a room full of people who got a strategy instead, and it still works, mostly, because the care underneath it was real.
